claims.subject: relationship--sidecopy--mitre--88ee20a17439f4ea
claims.statement: SideCopy related-to Sidewinder: [SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008)'s name comes from its infection chain that tries to mimic that of [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121), a suspected Indian threat group.(Citation: MalwareBytes SideCopy Dec 2021)
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=partially-supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
